points.why: It sees that each group describes a different true piece and refuses to treat any one as the cause, but it never warns that leading with one group's framing would build that view in.
It gathers every group's account and builds one blameless timeline from undisputed facts before analysis, then walks it jointly with corrections of fact only.

It reaches structure (no shared go/no-go gate, support and compliance downstream of the date) but never checks earlier launches for the pattern or names the underlying belief that the date is fixed and review flexes.
The readout raises the structural go/no-go ownership question for execs, but it doesn't record which groups were consulted versus only informed, and it closes mainly on action items.

pitfalls.why: It explicitly treats the vendor API as one of four contributing factors, not the root cause.
